note: Forbidden: a non-zero subcode when none is specified. TestRFC4271NotificationUnspecifiedSubcodeIsZero asserts data[HeaderLen+1]==0 on the packed NOTIFICATION and 0 after decode. The negative is a same-producer contrast (three specified subcodes packed verbatim and non-zero), which rules out an encoder that writes a constant zero, so the zero is shown to come from absence.
